source.title: The Developing Infant Creates a Curriculum for Statistical Learning

confidence_rationale: Strong, well-sourced review of head-camera and eye-tracker corpora showing that infant first-person visual input is not a stationary sample but a systematically ordered sequence of highly selective datasets that changes as sensorimotor capability changes. This is good evidence that biological development *is* curriculum-structured, which is the premise REE's brain-like-construction principle leans on. It is weak evidence for ARC-019 as stated, for two reasons that dominate the aggregate: the ordering is descriptive and correlational (no arm without it), and the curriculum is *emergent from the body* rather than imposed by explicit gates -- which is arguably an argument for letting REE's staging fall out of embodiment rather than for the InfantCurriculumScheduler's criterion gates.
failure_signatures: The infant curriculum is generated by changing sensorimotor capability, not by an external gate; if REE's staging is load-bearing only because it proxies an embodiment constraint the substrate does not otherwise have, then implementing the constraint directly would make the explicit gates redundant -- a distinct architecture from ARC-019.

No causal manipulation is available: nothing in this literature shows an infant given adult-like input from birth learns worse, so the observation that development is ordered cannot by itself discriminate ARC-019's CONFIRMING from its FALSIFYING branch.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The training sets for statistical learning develop as the sensorimotor abilities of the infant develop, yielding a series of ordered datasets for visual learning that differ in content and structure between timepoints but are highly selective at each timepoint.
mapping.ree_translation: REE's commitment to staged developmental training is biologically well-motivated: the natural learner does not face a stationary task distribution, and its early data is narrow and selective by construction. ARC-019's phase structure is the engineered analogue of that selectivity.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Descriptive-to-prescriptive transfer. That infant learning is curriculum-shaped does not establish that the curriculum is *why* it succeeds, nor that an explicit gate is the right way to reproduce it -- in the infant case the ordering is a downstream consequence of a maturing body, with no criterion test anywhere in the loop. Human visual development also runs on a budget orders of magnitude larger than any REE episode budget, so 'matched total budget' has no counterpart here at all.
mapping.source_context: Head-camera and eye-tracking corpora of infant first-person visual experience, 0-24 months; review.

confidence_components.notes: Aggregate weighted hard toward mapping_fidelity because ARC-019 is an architectural_commitment and this source cannot speak to the gate mechanism it commits to. Included because it is the strongest available statement of the biological premise, and because the alternative it suggests (staging as an emergent consequence of embodiment) is a live competitor architecture worth having on the record.
